name: Opel Blitz ambulance
identity: Supplied free-wwii-army-truck-collection-based-on-opel.zip ('all5 together.blend', collection 'medical van'): an Opel Blitz based 3 t truck. Creative Commons per the user (the archive itself names no author or licence variant): the baked model is committed.

model.note: converted by tools/vehicles/convert_vehicles.py opel 'medical van' (glass dropped, steering wheel cut out of the body)

rig.note: driver's eye = steering wheel centre + driverEyeFromSteer (left-hand drive); exits beside the doors, beside the body, behind, ahead

colliders.note: one body box in hull space from the baked hull bounds

carDrive.note: a 3 t truck: slower steering (4 turns lock to lock), heavier run-over hits

mobility.note: gameplay profile: 60 km/h on roads, 33 km/h off-road (Opel Blitz 3.6-36: 75 hp, ~85 km/h historical top speed)

ramming.note: Opel Blitz ~3.3 t empty plus load; 75 hp
